findings.evidence: Every app.js modal previously injected Sign out that invoked sessionExit.request; coordinator removed injection.
Old logs editor header/Escape could close during local or remote save; owner checks then invalidated response. New protectClose serializes close and keeps form if local persistence fails.
History handler initially targeted tracked lower editor even if account panel was above it. Coordinator added all-open-dialog stack; regression test proves only visible panel closes.
New form kind is stable Toolbox talk; legacy Portuguese Diálogo de segurança draft still classified/resumed without changing stored data.

No dedicated helpdesk, support-ticket entity or IT-request API/queue/history found. Existing support.js/contact.html only prepare mailto; general tasks and operational fault reports must not be mislabeled IT tickets.
support.js now builds localized draft message and queries current public version; both contact HTML pages replaced stale release labeling with version status.55 checks passed; no email was sent.

limits: Tests use actual JavaScript with a deterministic DOM/history harness; desktop/mobile browser navigation still requires coordinator integrated validation.
No production URL, data, database, account, permission, server process or repository publication was changed by this agent.
No message or email was sent.
No assertion that all application functions were exercised; independent coverage is explicit and focused.
